description: This file defines a LightningJS component called 'Loader' that displays three circles with animated fade-in and fade-out effects, used as a loading indicator.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component for displaying an animated loading indicator with three circles that fade in and out.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates a recurring interval that toggles the alpha value between 0 and 1 to create a blinking effect.
